name: Tagami (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tagami town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a disc, with a curved stroke at the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Tagami, a town in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1968.

features.role: Tagami town emblem — a ring enclosing a disc, with a curved stroke at the lower hoist
